time_source: actual raw time column in seconds; no interpolation, resampling, smoothing, or time shift
phase: P(...) raw radians; independently unwrap each JJ; phase delta/(2*pi) is navigation arithmetic only
integration: trapezoid over actual stored timestamps and exact half-open window rows; same JJ and same rows for phase/voltage cross-check
dout_semantics: DOUT_Dk and CBU_JOIN_Dk are joined through zero-volt current sensors; shared node voltage/area is not attributed to the array alone and is not an event count

descriptive_lobe_candidate_spec.meaning: descriptive voltage extrema only; not event or SFQ count
